title: Ship auger bit, 3/4 in x 18 in

sources.citation: An electrician's 18 in dual-flute ship auger family (one maker's product page, read 2026-11-15; maker not named in content) is offered, among other sizes, in 3/4, 7/8, 1 and 1-1/8 in hole diameters, for wet, dry and nail-embedded wood. The diameter is the nominal size in inches converted exactly (x 25.4 mm, NIST SP 811).

game-design: a wood-boring bit bores studs (step bore; no conductor size is involved, so no size limit). It cuts no steel box wall, so it opens no enclosure entry. Whether its hole suits a stud is the bored-hole limit and the edge distance (IRC R602.6 and NFPA 70 Art. 300.4(A)(1), by number), which the commands check.
